Principal Responsibilities
As an Application Developer within Institutional Bank Group, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and implementing innovative software solutions. Your responsibilities will include:
Software Development: Developing, testing, and deploying high-quality, scalable, and resilient applications, utilizing modern programming languages and frameworks.
Generative AI and Machine Learning: Engaging in the development and integration of Generative AI (GenAI) and Machine Learning (ML) models into financial applications, contributing to advanced analytical and predictive capabilities. This may involve working with GenAI/ML platforms and leveraging services.
System Design and Architecture: Participating in the architectural design of new and existing systems, ensuring they meet business requirements and adhere to best practices in terms of performance, security, and scalability.
DevOps and CI/CD: Implementing and maintaining Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to automate software delivery processes, ensuring efficient and reliable deployments.
Collaboration: Working closely with product managers and product owners to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions.
Troubleshooting and Support: Providing technical support and troubleshooting for production issues, ensuring high availability and performance of critical applications.
Documentation: Creating and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation for applications and systems.
Innovation: Staying abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, particularly in areas like AI/ML, cloud computing, and financial technology, to drive continuous improvement and innovation within the team.
Education And Relevant Experience
5+ years of working experience with Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
Strong proficiency in Java, familiar with Python.
Proven experience in software development, preferably within the financial services industry.
Solid understanding of relational and NoSQL databases.
Experience with middle ware service like Kafka, RocketMQ etc.
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP, OCP) and cloud-native application development.
Experience with DevOps principles and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
Experience with scripting languages like Bash, sh, etc. Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments.
Knowledge of financial markets products and processes is highly desirable.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in an agile, fast-paced, and collaborative environment.
Preferred Qualifications:
Front-end development experience (e.g., Angular, JavaScript, React) is a plus for full-stack roles.
Prior professional experience in FinTech, Top tier banking industry

The Opportunity
The CTO team is seeking a visionary, hands-on engineering leader to design, build, and scale HSBC Agent Platform as a core capability within the Group AI Platform. This role will deliver secure, reusable and high-performance platform services that enables team across the bank to build, deploy and operate agentic and generative AI solutions consistently, overing orchestration, tool integration, memory, evaluation and governance-by-design. You’ll set the technical direction, drive reliability and adoption at scale and ensure the platform meets enterprise standard for performance, resilience, security and controls.
What You’ll Do
Define the long-term technical vision and roadmap for the Agent platform in collaboration with product management team
Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of a robust, scalable, and high-performance Agent platform
Stay at the cutting edge of AI and agent movement in the industry, and adapt the agent platform to leverage the technical evolving in the industry
Work closely with technology teams across business lines to understand their requirements and ensure the platform empowers them to build agents efficiently
Integrate agent platform as part of the Group AI Platform which spans on-premise and cloud-based infrastructure
Build and manage a high-performing global team of ML SMEs and full stack engineers, to ensure the AI capabilities are built fit for purpose with high quality
Establish engineering best practices, including continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline workflows, automation testing framework, and monitoring systems for AI applications, and ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices
Implement observability, reliability, and performance optimizations for agent platform in production
Ensure compliance to architecture principle, technical standards, security requirements and software development life cycle controls
Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related subject area
15+ of experience in developing and implementing software solutions, with 5+ years in technical leadership roles.
Hands-on experience in design and development of agentic AI solutions
Proven and deep experience in designing, building, and delivering a large-scale Agent platform
Deep understanding of the agent paradigm, including agent planning, short-term and long-term memory, tool use, agent orchestration and agent evaluation
Experience with high code and low code agent platform
Strong experience in designing and building scalable and resilient platform
Proven ability in building and managing high performing teams of AI SME and full stack engineers
Solid hands-on development skills in programming language such as Java, Python, and CI/CD tools, automation testing, and observability
Proficiency in effective stakeholder management, and capable of effectively articulating AI capabilities, and influencing both business and technology leaders
Experience working in Agile development teams with excellent collaboration skills

Drive the implementation of global policies and procedures across ASP markets (e.g. AB&C, Conflict of Interest (GPAD), Information Control, Volcker, High Risk Role framework etc) and provide advisory guidance/ act as a subject matter expert to markets as needed.
Proactively engage with key stakeholders (e.g. first and second line of defense and Audit) to understand and resolve risks and issues.
Manage the implementation of key de-risking programs and support special BRR projects to mitigate the emerging risks as they arise.
Continue to improve the effectiveness and efficiency on how IWPB manage regulatory risk and controls.
Ensure efficient policy rollout and quality implementation of external regulatory changes in a timely manner by mobilising resources at the regional and market level.
Monitor the current and emerging risk and control environment. Lead risk read across initiatives and provide updates and escalation to senior management as needed.
Interpret regulations and Policy with the support of risk stewards and anticipate key problems and drive solutions. Provide policy related clarifications to markets to enable alignment across the region. Provide feedback to policy owners for possible improvements to policies.
Facilitate the FIM dispensation process by reviewing and recommending appropriate response to Senior Management and obtaining business approval for IWPB markets in the region.
Support the delivery of the Asia Culture and Conduct Programme agenda by driving initiatives and being key contact person for market champions.

Experience in regulatory risk and controls; preferable background in Audit, Regulatory Compliance/ Financial Crime Risk or other Business Management roles.
Good analytical skill with ability to understand and interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate into business requirements.
Well-developed leadership skills, not just at a team level but able to engage and drive at all levels, internally and externally.
Good communication skills, with ability to summarise complex topics concisely both verbally and in writing.
Good understanding of the regulatory landscape impacting the banking industry.
Detailed knowledge of how the organisation fits together across Global Businesses and Global Functions, and the ability to mobilise established networks to get things done.
Ability to drive the agenda, influence and communicate at all levels of the organisation.
Good understanding of customer segments/ financial services/ products across the WPB markets is preferable.
Self-starter, comfortable working with concepts, ambiguity and on their own initiative.
Broad experience of major programme or cross market/ region project management.

Principal Responsibilities
The HK Reference Data Business Analyst role is required to deliver accurate, controlled migration of Customer Reference Data to support the delivery of CDMS HK. You’ll work with business and centralised migration execution teams to support migration activities end-to-end (analysis, mapping, cleansing, testing, reconciliation, cutover support), partnering closely with Technology, Operations, Data Owners, and Change teams to ensure data is complete, consistent, and fit for purpose. This is an individual contributor role (G5) with no people management responsibilities.
Key Responsibilities Include Some Of But Not Limited To
Migration analysis & planning
Analyse source-to-target data movements for customer reference/master data domains (e.g., customer identifiers, names, addresses, contact details, tax residency indicators, KYC-related reference attributes).
Produce and maintain migration deliverables such as data scope, mapping specifications, transformation rules, data lineage notes, and reconciliation approach.
Support estimation and sequencing of migration waves; identify dependencies, assumptions, and constraints early.
Data quality, profiling & remediation
Perform data profiling to identify duplicates, missing values, invalid formats, and policy breaches.
Define and execute cleansing/remediation steps with Data Owners and upstream teams; track issues to closure.
Contribute to continuous improvement of data quality controls and repeatable migration playbooks.
Build support (requirements to engineering) & test execution
Translate business rules into clear requirements for ETL/configuration teams (or implement lightweight scripts where appropriate).
Create test scenarios and test data; execute SIT/UAT support activities focused on data outcomes.
Validate transformation logic through evidence-based checks (sampling + automated validations where possible).
Reconciliation, controls & cutover support
Run pre- and post-load reconciliations (record counts, key-field checks, exception reports, referential integrity checks).
Produce sign-off packs showing migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions with clear risk statements.
Support dress rehearsals and cutover weekend activities, including defect triage and rollback considerations.
Governance, risk & documentation
Ensure migration activities meet HSBC control expectations (audit trail, approvals, evidence retention, change controls).
Escalate risks/issues promptly with options and impact assessment.
Maintain high-quality documentation that can be understood by stakeholders across Hong Kong and global teams.
Stakeholder collaboration
Work effectively with Technology, Data Governance, Operations, Compliance/Financial Crime teams, and programme change resources.
Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions clearly—especially when trade-offs arise (time vs. quality vs. scope).
Key stakeholders
Technology (data engineering/ETL, application teams, testers)
Data Owners/Data Stewards
Operations/Customer Services teams (where data is originated/maintained)
Change/Programme Management
Risk & Compliance/Financial Crime (where data impacts controls and screening outcomes)
Requirements
Proven experience (typically 3–6 years) as a business and data analyst or similar in a complex, regulated environment (financial services preferred), working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
SQL (or equivalent) capability for data extraction, reconciliation and data analysis tasks.
Solid understanding of data quality management (profiling, controls, issue root-cause analysis) and working knowledge of data governance concepts (lineage, metadata, critical data elements).
Experience translating business requirements into analytical outputs (KPIs, metrics definitions, reporting packs), including documenting requirements and assumptions.
Exposure to reference/master data concepts and operating model practices (e.g., data standards, domain ownership, stewardship) is desirable.
Familiarity with Agile ways of working (user stories, sprint ceremonies) and collaborating effectively across business, operations and technology teams.
Strong communication skills: able to explain complex data findings clearly, challenge constructively, and influence outcomes with evidence.
Degree (or equivalent experience) in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics) or demonstrable applied analytical capability.
Experience working with operational teams to understand, map and improve end-to-end processes (e.g., SIPOC/process mapping), identifying data pain points, control gaps and opportunities for simplification/automation.
Proven involvement in data migration activities (e.g., legacy-to-target mapping, data profiling, transformation rules, reconciliation and post-migration validation), supporting cutover readiness and hypercare where required.
Working knowledge of process change governance (impacts, risks, controls, training/adoption considerations) and how process changes affect upstream/downstream data flows and reporting.

Practical experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated test suites.
Solid grasp of observability, incident management, SLO/SLI frameworks and reliability improvement cycles.

Background building financial card payment, digital banking, or card servicing platforms.
